list.definition: SELECT account FROM n360.account ORDER BY account

panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
Customers using all six features (the v1.1 definitions), the conversations that ran at least one playbook and the share handed off to an agent from within one, and the feature most customers should move to next (the first not adopted, in the agreed order n360.settings adoption_next_order: V8 / V9, Cortex, Recipes, then the rest). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_customer_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT topK(1)(next_feature)[1] FROM n360.v_customer_adoption WHERE next_feature != '' AND account IN (${account:singlequote})) AS common_next,
             (SELECT countIf(next_feature = common_next) FROM n360.v_customer_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})) AS n_next
        SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, concat(
                   toString(countIf(features_adopted = 6)), ' of ', concat(toString(count()), if(count() = 1, ' customer', ' customers')),
                   ' use all six features · playbooks ran in ', if(sum(conversations) IS NULL, NULL, if(sum(conversations) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(sum(conversations), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(sum(conversations), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(sum(conversations) % 1000), 3, '0')), if(sum(conversations) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(sum(conversations), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(sum(conversations) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(sum(conversations))))), ' conversations in 31 days, ',
                   toString(round(100 * sum(handoffs) / nullIf(sum(conversations), 0))), '% handed off',
                   if(common_next = '', '', concat(' · most common next step: ', common_next, ' (', toString(n_next), ')')))) AS sentence
        FROM n360.v_customer_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: Playbook executions, 31 days
panels.description:
Playbook executions on V8 VAs in the 31 days to the data-through day: the same figure as the v1.1 page's first tile. Not added to Cortex sessions or Explorer questions (different things). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.va_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, sum(executions)) AS `across every V8 playbook` FROM n360.v_customer_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Handed off from a playbook
panels.description:
Handoffs to an agent from within a playbook, as a share of the conversations that ran at least one playbook. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.va_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(sum(conversations) = 0, NULL, round(100 * sum(handoffs) / sum(conversations), 1)) AS `of conversations that ran one`
        FROM n360.v_customer_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: VAs on V8 or later
panels.description:
VAs whose weekly configuration read shows V8 or later; change against the read 30 days earlier.

**Source:** n360.va_config_snapshot  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** weekly reads, the last 30 days

targets.rawSql:
WITH nightly AS (SELECT snapshot_date AS night, toUInt64(countIf(engine_major >= (SELECT engine_current_major FROM n360.settings))) AS value
        FROM n360.va_config_snapshot WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY night),
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly) AS newest,
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly WHERE night <= newest - 30) AS ref_30,
             (SELECT min(night) FROM nightly) AS oldest,
             if(ref_30 IS NULL OR ref_30 = toDate(0), if(oldest < newest, oldest, NULL), ref_30) AS ref,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = newest) AS v_now,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = ref) AS v_then
        SELECT toDateTime(night) AS time, value, if(ref IS NULL, 'no earlier night stored', concat(multiIf(v_now > v_then, concat('+', toString(v_now - v_then)), v_now < v_then, concat('−', toString(v_then - v_now)), 'no change'), ' since ', toString(toDayOfMonth(ref)), ' ', formatDateTime(ref, '%b'))) AS change
        FROM nightly WHERE night > newest - 30 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Customers on all six features
panels.description:
Customers that have adopted every one of the six features (the grid below shows where the rest stand). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_customer_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, countIf(features_adopted = 6)) AS `customers` FROM n360.v_customer_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Six features, every customer
panels.description:
Each customer against the six features of the v1.1 Adoption view. A cell is green when adopted, amber when partly (for example tests run with validation off, or calibration lapsed), light grey when not yet, grey when the source has nothing ("Not reported yet", never "not yet"). Hover a column heading for what adopted means. Adopted, of 6 is drawn as a bar. Next step: the first feature not adopted, in the agreed order (n360.settings adoption_next_order). Click a customer for its VAs and playbooks. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_customer_feature_adoption, n360.v_customer_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name AS Customer, c.features_adopted AS `Adopted, of 6`, anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'Cortex') AS `Cortex`,
               anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'Test / playbook validation') AS `Testing`,
               anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'Calibration') AS `Calibration`,
               anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'V8 / V9') AS `V8 / V9`,
               anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'Action-oriented recipes') AS `Recipes`,
               anyIf(concat(f.state, '|', f.value), f.feature = 'Explorer') AS `Explorer`,
               if(c.next_feature = '', 'Every feature adopted', c.next_feature) AS `Next step`,
               c.executions AS `Executions, 31 days`, c.handoff_pct AS `Handed off`, a.account AS account
        FROM n360.v_customer_feature_adoption AS f INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = f.account
        INNER JOIN n360.v_customer_adoption AS c ON c.account = f.account
        WHERE f.account IN (${account:singlequote})
        GROUP BY a.display_name, a.account, c.features_adopted, c.next_feature, c.executions, c.handoff_pct
        ORDER BY `Adopted, of 6` DESC, `Executions, 31 days` DESC

properties.value: Used to create or edit a production playbook in the last 30 days. Cortex is read for US VAs only and has no user id: whether Netomi or the customer ran a session is not known yet.
Run on every playbook version before promotion (Behavior Validation on, with test runs). Runs with validation off = partly.
At least monthly on Tier 1 and Tier 2 use cases: a run in the last 31 days (n360.settings adoption_calibration_days). An older run = partly (lapsed).
Production VA running on V8 or V9; target 100%. A customer is adopted only when every VA is.
At least one production recipe performs a write against a customer system. Recipes built but none writing in production = partly.
At least one question by a customer user in the last 30 days, in Production or Staging; Netomi staff not counted.
The first of the six not adopted, in the agreed order V8 / V9 → Cortex → Recipes → Testing → Calibration → Explorer.

panels.title: Where each feature stands
panels.description:
For each feature, how many customers have adopted it, partly, not yet, or are not reported. Hover a bar for the counts. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_customer_feature_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT feature AS Feature, countIf(state = 'adopted') AS `Adopted`,
               countIf(state = 'partly') AS `Partly`,
               countIf(state = 'none') AS `Not yet`,
               countIf(state = 'not reported') AS `Not reported yet`
        FROM n360.v_customer_feature_adoption WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY ord, feature ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Next step queue
panels.description:
Customers grouped by the next feature to move them to (the first of the six not adopted, in the agreed order n360.settings adoption_next_order), with the playbook traffic behind them: the biggest group with the most traffic is the campaign to run first. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_customer_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(c.next_feature = '', 'Every feature adopted', c.next_feature) AS `Next step`,
               count() AS Customers, arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupArray(a.display_name)), ', ') AS Who,
               sum(c.executions) AS `Their executions, 31 days`,
               indexOf((SELECT adoption_next_order FROM n360.settings), c.next_feature) AS o
        FROM n360.v_customer_adoption AS c INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY c.next_feature ORDER BY o = 0, o

panels.title: Playbook estate by customer
panels.description:
Per customer: VAs on V8 or later, playbooks live and how many ran in 31 days, live-but-idle playbooks, executions (bar), conversations that ran a playbook, the share handed off from within one, and the legacy intents still to move. Click a customer to open its adoption. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_customer_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 31 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name AS Customer, concat(toString(c.vas_v8), ' of ', toString(c.vas)) AS `VAs on V8+`,
               c.playbooks_live AS `Playbooks live`, c.playbooks_executed AS `Ran in 31 days`, c.idle_playbooks AS `Live but idle`,
               c.executions AS Executions, c.conversations AS `Conversations with a playbook`, c.handoff_pct AS `Handed off`,
               c.legacy_intents AS `Legacy intents left`, concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(c.last_execution)), ' ', formatDateTime(c.last_execution, '%b %Y')) AS `Last execution`, a.account AS account
        FROM n360.v_customer_adoption AS c INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY Executions DESC

panels.title: Playbook length, by customer
panels.description:
Production playbooks per customer by the length of their instructions (characters), shortest band palest. Long playbooks (10,000+) are the hardest to test and to change; short ones (under 200) may be placeholders. Hover for the counts. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name AS Customer, countIf(length_band = '<200 (short)') AS `<200 (short)`,
               countIf(length_band = '200-999') AS `200-999`,
               countIf(length_band = '1000-2999') AS `1000-2999`,
               countIf(length_band = '3000-5999') AS `3000-5999`,
               countIf(length_band = '6000-9999') AS `6000-9999`,
               countIf(length_band = '10000+') AS `10000+`
        FROM n360.v_playbook AS pb INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = pb.account
        WHERE pb.account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY Customer ORDER BY count() DESC

panels.title: Who builds the playbooks
panels.description:
Each customer's production playbooks by who created them (the creator's email domain: Netomi's domain = Netomi, any other = the customer, n360.settings adoption_staff_domain), as a share. The customers at the top build for themselves; at the bottom, Netomi does the work. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name AS Customer, countIf(pb.built_by = 'Customer') AS `The customer`, countIf(pb.built_by = 'Netomi') AS Netomi,
               countIf(pb.built_by IS NULL) AS `Not reported`
        FROM n360.v_playbook AS pb INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = pb.account
        WHERE pb.account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY Customer ORDER BY countIf(pb.built_by = 'Customer') / count() DESC

panels.title: Cortex sessions per day
panels.description:
Cortex sessions per day, stacked by customer (US VAs only; who ran a session is not known yet). Read since 5 Oct 2026; a day read with no session is 0. Hover for every customer that day.

**Source:** n360.cortex_day  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(c.day) AS time, a.display_name AS Customer, sum(c.authoring_sessions) AS Sessions
        FROM n360.cortex_day AS c INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(c.day) GROUP BY time, Customer ORDER BY time

panels.title: The move to V8, week by week
panels.description:
Each weekly configuration read: VAs on V8 or later (green) and below (amber), and the legacy intents still configured (dashed, right axis): the upgrade backlog shrinking.

**Source:** n360.va_config_snapshot  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range, weekly reads

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(snapshot_date) AS time,
               countIf(engine_major >= (SELECT engine_current_major FROM n360.settings)) AS `V8 or later`,
               countIf(engine_major < (SELECT engine_current_major FROM n360.settings)) AS `Below V8`,
               sum(legacy_intents) AS `Legacy intents left`
        FROM n360.va_config_snapshot WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(snapshot_date) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Longest playbooks
panels.description:
The 15 longest production playbooks (instruction characters, drawn as a bar), with their tools and traffic. Long and busy = worth splitting or testing first. Click a VA for its playbooks. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pb.playbook AS Playbook, a.display_name AS Customer, pb.va AS VA, pb.instruction_chars AS `Instructions (characters)`,
               pb.tools AS Tools, pb.executions AS `Executions, 31 days`, ifNull(pb.built_by, '') AS `Built by`,
               pb.account AS account, toString(pb.bot_id) AS bot
        FROM n360.v_playbook AS pb INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = pb.account
        WHERE pb.account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY `Instructions (characters)` DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Live but idle: no run in 31 days
panels.description:
V8 playbooks in production with no execution in their window: built, switched on, never triggered. Check the trigger, or retire them. Click a VA for its playbooks. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pb.playbook AS Playbook, a.display_name AS Customer, pb.va AS VA, pb.instruction_chars AS `Instructions (characters)`,
               ifNull(pb.built_by, '') AS `Built by`, pb.account AS account, toString(pb.bot_id) AS bot
        FROM n360.v_playbook AS pb INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = pb.account
        WHERE pb.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND pb.idle ORDER BY Customer, VA

panels.title: Upgrade queue: VAs below V8, busiest first
panels.description:
VAs still on an engine older than V8, ranked by conversations in the last 30 days: the first row is the one to upgrade next (most traffic moves). Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_va_change, n360.va_adoption  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read; the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.va AS VA, a.display_name AS Customer, ad.engine_version AS Engine, ad.legacy_intents AS `Legacy intents`,
               c.convs_30 AS `Conversations, 30 days`,
               concat('/d/n360-adoption-va?var-account=', c.account, '&var-va=', toString(c.bot_id)) AS drill
        FROM n360.v_va_change AS c INNER JOIN n360.va_adoption AS ad ON ad.bot_id = c.bot_id
        INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND ad.engine_major < (SELECT engine_current_major FROM n360.settings)
        ORDER BY `Conversations, 30 days` DESC

defaults.noValue: Every VA is on V8 or later

panels.title: Configuration changes since the last read
panels.description:
What changed per VA between its two newest weekly configuration reads.

**Source:** n360.v_va_config_change  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the two newest reads per VA

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, ac.display_name AS Customer, concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(ch.snapshot_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(ch.snapshot_date, '%b %Y')) AS `Read on`,
               arrayStringConcat(ch.changes, '; ') AS Changes,
               concat('/d/n360-adoption-va?var-account=', ch.account, '&var-va=', toString(ch.bot_id)) AS drill
        FROM n360.v_va_config_change AS ch INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = ch.bot_id
        INNER JOIN n360.account AS ac ON ac.account = ch.account
        WHERE ch.account IN (${account:singlequote})

defaults.noValue: No changes since the last read

panels.n360MayBeEmpty: no change since the last read

panels.title: Containment by channel
panels.description:
Containment per VA, grouped by channel (never one number across channels), last 30 days against the 30 before; the change is in points (▼ down, ▲ up). VAs without handoff data are on the Containment dashboard.

**Source:** n360.v_va_change  
**Filter:** Customer; VAs with handoff data  
**Window:** the 60 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.channel AS Channel, c.va AS VA, a.display_name AS Customer, c.containment_30 AS `Last 30 days`,
               c.containment_prev_30 AS `30 before`,
               multiIf(c.containment_change_pts IS NULL, NULL, c.containment_change_pts >= 1, concat('▲ ', toString(c.containment_change_pts)),
                       c.containment_change_pts <= -1, concat('▼ ', toString(abs(c.containment_change_pts))), '● steady') AS Change,
               concat('/d/n360-va?var-account=', c.account, '&var-va=', toString(c.bot_id)) AS drill
        FROM n360.v_va_change AS c INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND c.containment_30 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Channel, `Last 30 days`

panels.title: Target features used (the risk model's list)
panels.description:
The five target features the risk model and the Overview count ("customers using 3+ target features"): used in the last 30 days (green) or not (light grey); "Not reported yet" where the source has no rows.

**Source:** n360.v_feature_use  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name AS Customer, anyIf(if(f.used IS NULL, NULL, if(f.used, 'Used', 'Not used')), f.feature = 'V8 playbooks') AS `V8 playbooks`,
               anyIf(if(f.used IS NULL, NULL, if(f.used, 'Used', 'Not used')), f.feature = 'Cortex') AS `Cortex`,
               anyIf(if(f.used IS NULL, NULL, if(f.used, 'Used', 'Not used')), f.feature = 'Explorer') AS `Explorer`,
               anyIf(if(f.used IS NULL, NULL, if(f.used, 'Used', 'Not used')), f.feature = 'MCP servers') AS `MCP servers`,
               anyIf(if(f.used IS NULL, NULL, if(f.used, 'Used', 'Not used')), f.feature = 'Supervisory rules') AS `Supervisory rules`, a.account AS account
        FROM n360.account AS a INNER JOIN n360.v_feature_use AS f ON f.account = a.account
        WHERE a.account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY a.display_name, a.account ORDER BY Customer

panels.title: Cortex sessions: Netomi and the customer
panels.description:
Cortex sessions per customer, split by who ran them: Netomi (blue-grey) or the customer's own users (green). Hover for the counts. A customer whose bar is all Netomi depends on Netomi to change its playbooks. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name AS Customer, sumIf(c.sessions, c.who = 'Netomi') AS Netomi,
               sumIf(c.sessions, c.who = 'Customer') AS `The customer`
        FROM n360.v_cortex_user AS c INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(c.day) GROUP BY Customer ORDER BY sum(c.sessions) DESC

panels.title: Executions: Netomi-built and customer-built playbooks
panels.description:
Playbook executions in 31 days, split by who created the playbook (creator domain): Netomi (blue-grey) or the customer (green), as a share. Hover for the counts. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named. Newest read of the Adoption detail tables (docs/25): the pipeline replaces them whole each night, so these are the 31-day window to the data-through day, not the dashboard's time range.

**Source:** n360.v_playbook  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the newest read

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name AS Customer, sumIf(pb.executions, pb.built_by = 'Netomi') AS `Built by Netomi`,
               sumIf(pb.executions, pb.built_by = 'Customer') AS `Built by the customer`,
               sumIf(pb.executions, pb.built_by IS NULL) AS `Builder not reported`
        FROM n360.v_playbook AS pb INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = pb.account
        WHERE pb.account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY Customer ORDER BY sum(pb.executions) DESC
